objective: Add a narrowly scoped ci/heavy/** push trigger for reproducible source-backed heavy scientific validation execution.

baseline.description: Heavy scientific validation is available only through schedule or manual dispatch.

reproducibility.reason: Post-change CI and a dedicated heavy-validation branch execution are required.

scientific_validity.reason: The dedicated heavy-validation branch has not yet executed source-backed acquisition.

evidence: The push trigger is restricted to branches matching ci/heavy/**.
Existing pull_request, schedule, and workflow_dispatch triggers remain preserved.
validation.blocker: Post-change CI and dedicated heavy source-backed execution are required before this lifecycle stage is finalized.

root_causes: The available GitHub connector does not expose workflow_dispatch write capability.
Heavy scientific validation therefore lacked an autonomous execution path.

findings: Expensive source-backed validation should have a narrowly scoped reproducible execution trigger in addition to scheduled and manual execution.

open_blockers: Dedicated ci/heavy/** execution must complete and emit source-backed evidence.
